record.dic_text:
07619 Sh@buw'el {sheb-oo-ale'} 或 Shuwba'el {shoo-baw-ale'}

源自 07617 (簡略型) 或 07725 與 0410; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Shebuel 3, Shubael 3; 6

細布業 或 書巴業 = "神的俘虜"

1) 革舜的兒子, 摩西的孫子
2) 希幔的兒子之一
record.edic_text:
07619 Sh@buw'el {sheb-oo-ale'} or Shuwba'el {shoo-baw-ale'}

from 07617 (abbrev) or 07725 and 0410;; n pr m

AV - Shebuel 3, Shubael 3; 6

Shebuel or Shubael = "captive of God"
1) son of Gershom and grandson of Moses
2) one of the 14 sons of Heman the musician
